reputation.title: Reputation
reputation.helpIntro: Each seller's reputation is computed by tradepost from what happened in their sales over the last 90 days. Nothing is self-reported: only facts recorded on the platform count.

inputs.cancellations: Cancellations and refunds after payment, including through a dispute.
inputs.late: Late shipments: more than 3 days between payment and shipping.

rules.top: 10 or more sales, at most 2% cancellations, at most 5% late shipments and an average rating of 4.5 or more.
rules.good: 3 or more sales, at most 5% cancellations, at most 15% late shipments and an average rating of 4 or more.
rules.new: Fewer than 3 completed sales in the last 90 days.
rules.attention: Cancellations, delays or ratings outside the limits of the other levels.

reputation.helpFooter: Without ratings, the level depends only on sales, cancellations and delays. It is recomputed on every view.

explain.seller_rejected: The seller declined. The buyer can ask tradepost to decide.
explain.refunded: The refund went back to the original payment method.
